headline: Stlican Shelf Rages as DeadLands and Godcrofts Reawaken
war_summary: Since the last edition, the principal front has not shifted: Stlican Shelf remains the busiest region on the map, with four strategic-base events in the final two hours, twenty-two in six, and forty-six on the day. The Pale House and Vulpine Watch are the most contested points there. Weathered Expanse has also quickened, posting five events in two hours and seven in six, with Spirit Watch the busiest base and casualties climbing on both sides. DeadLands, quiet in the preceding bulletin, has returned to the list with two fresh events in two hours and eleven in the past day, most at Callahan's Boot, amid the war's heaviest casualties. Godcrofts has likewise reawakened, showing two events in two hours and eleven in twenty-four, centred on Argosa. Stonecradle keeps up a steady drumbeat at The Long Fast, with two events in two hours and twelve on the day. Callahan's Passage, prominent earlier, has slackened in the latest two-hour window; its last recorded event at The Latch came near eight o'clock. No victory has been declared.
